snippet.title: GPS Spoofing Data Center Thefts
snippet.description:
Writer: Brett Stelmaszek
Editor: Dawid Wilsnach
Music by: @UFD-Music

Now AI data centers have to worry about Fast & Furious style hijackings.
Recently, there were the would-be thieves who tried to steal an Nvidia-labeled big rig that was just hauling sand and not graphics cards.
But the folks who get away with it are being much more intelligent and intense with their efforts. In just the few months since June over a hundred million dollars of data center gear has been lifted from trucks that are hauling things like RAM, copper, fibre optic lines and GPUs to the construction sites.
The methods involve things like GPS-spoofing the trailers location, potential AI-generated ID forgery to impersonate the real truck driver, and just the ole reliable physical intimidation to get the goods.
But the coordinated campaigns don’t appear to be for petty thieves who are just going to try to flip things on the black market or Facebook marketplace, but it appears the boosted products are instead making their way to other data centers in China.  Because of all the exporting restrictions from the US, a heist appears to be a reliable way for them to get access to the parts they need.

snippet.title: Spider-Man’s Scrapped Goblin Mask
snippet.description:
For Spider-Man (2002), director Sam Raimi’s team first had Amalgamated Dynamics build an animatronic Green Goblin mask. It was a more monstrous design, closer to the horror style of Raimi’s Evil Dead films than to the comics, and it could show a full range of emotions. The mask was scrapped because of technical problems, and studio executives reportedly found it too creepy. 

Reports also say its moving parts and shoulder-mounted rig were slow to apply and uncomfortable to wear. Willem Dafoe, cast as Norman Osborn in November 2000, wore a replacement armored suit instead. It had 580 pieces and took about half an hour to put on. Dafoe insisted on wearing it himself, believing a stuntman couldn’t convey the character’s body language.
